wet_tarmac.note: Scale applies to a wet-loss coefficient, NOT directly to peak grip. Only this physical-material asset is edited.

offline_guard.connection_check: BLoggedOn: false means currently disconnected, not proof of persistent Offline Mode
offline_guard.http_scope: Audited Unreal HTTP configuration/read and request preflight failure branch

notes: Stock delegates to native settings; it does not disable the underlying system.
Tyre damage overrides only compression-rate reads in the puncture routine. Probability, critical/session gates and wear-grip behavior remain.
Brake switch opens the native disc/pad consumption gate, not a wear-rate multiplier. Clutch/differential consumption not patched.
Mechanical thresholds change eligibility, not fixed failure probability. Native distance/chance/resistance/state checks remain.
Attachment override replaces the global constrained-component threshold factor at three read sites; per-car/per-component scales and breakability remain.

critical_damage.scope: Allow native authored Critical states at the existing collision and mechanical-failure health-update call sites. Does not add health loss, bypass damage-enable conditions, change failure odds, or create cooling/transmission effects.

collision_repairs.scope: Component-local cooling socket fallback to existing Socket_Audio_Engine; engine-only collision coefficient x4. No guessed cooling, torque, steering, or gearbox model.
collision_repairs.fallback_set_requirement: Compact allocated singleton, exact unsuffixed ANSI dedicated name; same component lacks dedicated socket

power_response.Progressive: Cap EngineTorqueMult at health/0.85 and TurboEffMult at health/0.70; cap cannot increase native output

wheel_impact.Stock: Native uniform amount for eligible sockets
wheel_impact.Localized: For the four named suspension hubs only, weight=2*max(0,1-distance/nativeRadius)

limitations: Socket-map routing, not all collision routes
Cooling and gearbox response curves unchanged

gearbox_damage.grinding: Effective local native mechanical-damage rate 1.00 only with native damage and simulation flags enabled; other damage systems unchanged
gearbox_damage.impact: Gearbox loses 50% of the engine actual collision health-fraction loss, through native component health/effects; no transfer from ordinary engine wear
gearbox_damage.critical: When Cumulative is selected, permits native GearBox critical state on accumulator-driven updates; other parts retain original permission
limits: Optional new impact tuning, not stock collision routing
No promised shift failure on every damaged gear change
No new damage when engine takes no further collision HP loss
